lore_cards: The city trends in cycles; crowns are just cached attention.
A fan-light can guide or blind depending on who holds it.
Every rumor leaves a footprint in the signal fog.
Archived songs still hum under the stage floor.
They said princesses wait to be saved. They recompiled the script.
A perfect image cracks fastest under live lights.
The loudest boos become bass when synced.
Tiaras are antennas for courage, not approval.
In this city, silence is a stealth mechanic.
Final boss truth: disbandment is a narrative, not fate.
Crowns are cached attention; threads are trauma bonds.
The louder the noise, the emptier the signal.
Every follow is a contract, every like a leash.
They came for the spotlight but found the shadows instead.

miho: My flames will protect SUPERNOVA forever~
hyunju: I feel everything... and I'll share it all~
Feel the heartbeat of the crowd!
sujin: Data doesn't lie, but I might.
sohee: I'm scared... but I won't let you down.
